question:
There is a spelling error in the given sentence. Select the option that contains the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

The mighty gaint brought a marigold for the princess.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"gaint"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is** "giant"**. (विशालकाय)

 
 
• **Example:** The giant towered over the small village, casting a long shadow.
 
 
 
• **"Giant"** refers to something or someone of great size, strength, or importance. (विशालकाय)
 
 
• **Example:** The giant tree stood in the middle of the forest, its branches stretching out wide.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Princess** (राजकुमारी): The daughter of a monarch.

 
 
• **Example:** The** princess** wore a beautiful gown to the royal ball.
 
 
 
• **Marigold** (गेंदा): A type of flowering plant.
 
 
• **Example:** The garden was full of bright yellow **marigolds.**
 
 
 
• **Mighty** (शक्तिशाली): Possessing great and impressive power or strength.
 
 
• **Example:** The** mighty** lion roared in the jungle.
